about: Boggan waa akhris kaliya. Beddelka la doortay waxay dhaxlaan xilliga dhicitaanka ee jira. Saraakiishu ma dhaafi karaan, ma dib dhigi karaan, ma beddeli karaan, mana dheereyn karaan muddada doorashada boggan.
appointed_scope: Magacaabista shaqaynaysa ee lagu diiwaangeliyay goobtan. Kuwani waxay isticmaalaan taariikhdooda magacaabista.
appointment_settings: Dhererka magacaabista ee loo habeeyay: rayid {civil} sano; garsoorka {judicial} sano. Saf kasta wuxuu tusayaa taariikhda dhicitaanka ee dhabta ah.
choose_help: Fur meel kasta oo dooro Jadwalka Muddada ee agta golaha sharci-dejinta iyo khariidadaha. Degganaanshahaagu ma xaddido goobta aad arki karto.
clock_help: Taariikhda jadwalka waxay ka timaadaa saacadda doorashada ee hubaysan. Habaynta waxay sharraxdaa muddada loo qorsheeyay; ma beddelaan taariikhaha diiwaangashan ee muddada socota.
elected_scope: Muddada shaqaynaysa ee ku xiran golaha sharci-dejinta ee la doortay ee goobtan.
intro: Akhri muddada diiwaangashan iyo jadwalka doorashada ee goobta la doortay.
no_legislature: Ma jiraan golaha sharci-dejinta oo lagu diiwaangeliyay goobtan.
no_refusals: Ma jiraan diidmo saacadeed oo ku xiran goobtan oo la diiwaangeliyay.
no_terms: Ma jiraan muddooyin firfircoon oo lagu diiwaangeliyay baaxaddan.
place_elected_scope: Muddada doorashada ee shaqaynaysa ee lagu diiwaangeliyay goobtan. Goobaha codbixiyayaashu waxay leeyihiin diiwaanno u gaar ah.
refusal_scope: Qoraalladan waxay ku xiran yihiin goobtan ee diiwaanka hanti-dhowrka. Qoraallada aan lahayn goob la diiwaangeliyay lama xiriirin karo muuqaalkan.
select_clock: Dooro golaha sharci-dejinta si aad u akhriso muddada la diiwaangeliyay iyo jadwalka doorashada.
title: Jadwalka muddada
